name: volleyball-manager
description: Volleyball Manager — club seasons, rosters, and live game stats

scripts.build: npm run build -w @volleyball-manager/shared-types && npm run build -w @volleyball-manager/database && npm run build -w @volleyball-manager/api-server && npm run build -w @volleyball-manager/web-client
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.smoke: node scripts/smoke-first-slice.mjs && node scripts/smoke-volunteer.mjs && node scripts/smoke-ical.mjs && node scripts/smoke-announcements.mjs && node scripts/smoke-notes.mjs && node scripts/smoke-teams.mjs && node scripts/smoke-dues.mjs && node scripts/smoke-theme.mjs && node scripts/smoke-archive.mjs
